facts.business: TCI Express Limited provides multimodal logistics services including surface, rail, air, and international express solutions across India and globally.

auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: GST Demand on account of GST payable on reverse charge mechanism, amounting to ₹ 51.36 Crores along with applicable interest and penalty. Appeal rejected by Commissioner (Appeals) on 30th December 2025; Company intends to appeal to Appellate Authority. Management confident of prevailing and no adjustments envisaged.

key_risks: GST demand and litigation risk on reverse charge mechanism
Implementation of New Labour Codes impacting employee benefit obligations
facts.related_party_note: TCI Express Pte. Ltd., Singapore (wholly owned subsidiary) acquired TCI Global (Singapore) Pte. Ltd. by way of transfer from TCI Holdings Asia Pacific Pte. Ltd., a step-down WOS of Transport Corporation of India Limited (TCIL).
